subject: reasoning
question:
H, I, J, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Q sits to the immediate right of J. Only three people sit between Q and S when counted from the left of Q. Only three people sit between J and H. P sits to the immediate right of R.

How many people sit between J and R when counted from the right of R?
solution:
Given: H, I, J, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Q sits to the immediate right of J.

2) Only three people sit between Q and S when counted from the left of Q.

3) Only three people sit between J and H.

4) P sits to the immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88be603c331730ddade7528f75d35bdca7326f978f1a2ff73a26532f5e8339f7.png] 

Here, **One** person sit between J and R when counted from the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
